{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Increased the adoption tax credit and the child care tax credit.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and the Republican Congress passed the Jobs and Growth Act of 2003.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Jobs and Growth Act of 2003 assisted economic recovery by accelerating the 2001 tax relief and encouraging investment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The tax rates on capital gains and dividend income were reduced to 15 percent to encourage saving and investment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Seven million senior citizens are benefiting from the tax relief on dividend income.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The law quadrupled small business expensing to allow entrepreneurs to deduct the first $100,000 of investment from their taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because of the 2001 and 2003 tax cuts, 111 million families are receiving an average tax cut of over $1,500.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The overall tax burden on working Americans is the lowest it has been in 37 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Good government is based on a system of limited taxes and spending.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should be limited and restricted to the functions mandated by the United States Constitution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The taxation system should not be used to redistribute wealth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The taxation system should not be used to fund ever-increasing entitlements and social programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
